edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the sender into transfer.
msg.sender is used as spender/recipient context in transferFrom.
msg.sender is recorded as the allowance owner in approve.
amount parameter flows into _transfer validation and token math.
from parameter flows into blacklist and pair checks in _transfer.
to parameter flows into exclusion and pair checks in _transfer.
transfer delegates execution to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates execution to _transfer.
transferFrom calls _approve to decrement the allowance.
_approve writes the _allowances mapping.
_transfer ends by calling _tokenTransfer.
_tokenTransfer dispatches to _transferStandard.
_transferStandard calls _getValues to compute amounts.
_getValues calls _getTValues.
_getValues calls _getRValues.
_getValues calls _getRate for the current reflection rate.
_getRate calls _getCurrentSupply for supply values.
_rTotal participates in the reflection supply division; inconsistent supply math can distort balances.
_tTotal is used as divisor basis in supply/rate computation.
_transferStandard updates _rOwned balances of sender and recipient.
_transferStandard calls _takeTeam for the team fee.
_transferStandard calls _reflectFee for the reflection fee.
_takeTeam adds team reflections to the contract's _rOwned balance.
_reflectFee subtracts rFee from _rTotal, mutating the reflection supply used in rate math.
_reflectFee increments the accumulated fee counter _tFeeTotal.
tAmount parameter drives the amount computation in _transferStandard.
tFee local is consumed by _reflectFee.
tTeam local is consumed by _takeTeam.
contractTokenBalance is passed as tokenAmount into swapTokensForEth.
_transfer triggers swapTokensForEth which performs an external router call before state finalization of the user transfer.
swapTokensForEth reads the stored uniswapV2Router reference.
swapTokensForEth makes an external swap call with amountOutMin 0 and no protective reentrancy guard on the ETH path.
The external router/swap interaction can re-enter transfer logic while state is mid-update.
block.timestamp is supplied as the router deadline, a miner-influenced value.
swapTokensForEth uses the lockTheSwap modifier toggling inSwap.
_transfer calls sendETHToFee when the contract ETH balance exceeds the threshold.
sendETHToFee performs outgoing ETH transfers.
ETH is pushed to the hardcoded fee wallet 1.
ETH is pushed to the hardcoded fee wallet 2.
ETH is pushed to the hardcoded fee wallet 3.
openTrading performs an external addLiquidityETH call with zero minimums.
openTrading performs an external createPair call on the factory.
block.timestamp is used as the liquidity deadline.
openTrading stores the new router address in uniswapV2Router.
openTrading stores the created pair in uniswapV2Pair.
openTrading sets tradingOpen to true.
openTrading calls _approve for router and pair allowances.
onlyOwner reads _owner to compare against the caller.
The untrusted caller address is compared to _owner in the onlyOwner modifier.
onlyOwner gates openTrading.
onlyOwner gates liftMaxTx.
onlyOwner gates setCooldownEnabled.
onlyOwner gates renounceOwnership.
manualswap requires _msgSender() == _feeAddrWallet1, an address-based privilege check.
manualsend requires _msgSender() == _feeAddrWallet1, an address-based privilege check.
_feeAddrWallet1 is the trusted address compared against the caller in manualswap.
manualswap calls swapTokensForEth on the full contract balance.
manualsend calls sendETHToFee with the full contract ETH balance.
onoff parameter is written into cooldownEnabled.
account parameter indexes _rOwned inside balanceOf.
spender parameter flows into the approval write.
currentRate local is produced by _getRate inside _takeTeam.
_transfer reads the bots blacklist mapping to block addresses without an owner-controlled unblacklist path.
_transfer reads cooldownEnabled to decide whether to enforce the max transaction amount.
_transfer reads _maxTxAmount for the buy-side limit check.
_transfer compares from against uniswapV2Pair to detect swaps.
_transfer reads swapEnabled before triggering an automatic swap.
liftMaxTx writes the maximum transaction amount back to full supply.
_transfer assigns the tax fee percentage _feeAddr1.
_transfer assigns the team fee percentage _feeAddr2.
_feeAddr1 is used as taxFee in _getTValues.
_feeAddr2 is used as TeamFee in _getTValues.
balanceOf reads the _rOwned balance for the queried account.
